scrapedWebsitePages.fixed_diposit_page_data: Home>Case Studies>Fixed Deposit IntegrationFixed Deposit Integration in Financial AppThird-Party SDK Integration for Digital BankingIndustry:FinTech / Digital Banking / Financial ServicesProject Type:Third-Party Fixed Deposit SDK IntegrationPlatform:Mobile Banking App + Backend API IntegrationOverviewA digital banking platform wanted to expand its financial product offerings by enabling customers to open Fixed Deposits (FDs) directly from their mobile application.To accelerate development and ensure regulatory compliance, the client decided to integrate a trusted third-party Fixed Deposit SDK that provides access to multiple banking partners and financial institutions.Our team implemented the SDK within the existing financial application, enabling users to discover FD plans, compare interest rates, and invest seamlessly without leaving the app.ProblemThe client's mobile banking application lacked investment products beyond basic savings accounts and payments. Customers had to visit external banking portals or physical branches to open Fixed Deposits, resulting in a fragmented user experience.The client required a secure integration that could enable FD investments directly within the app while ensuring compliance with financial regulations and maintaining a seamless user experience.SolutionWe integrated a third-party Fixed Deposit SDK into the financial mobile application, enabling customers to browse FD products from multiple partner banks.The SDK provided secure APIs for listing available deposit plans, calculating interest earnings, and initiating FD investments directly within the app interface.The integration also supported KYC verification, transaction tracking, and real-time updates on deposit status, ensuring a fully digital investment journey.Key Functional ModulesFD Plan Discovery & ComparisonReal-time Interest Rate CalculationThird-Party SDK IntegrationSecure Payment ProcessingKYC & User VerificationInvestment Tracking DashboardKey OutcomesSeamlessIn-App Fixed Deposit InvestmentsSecureFinancial Transactions via SDK IntegrationImprovedUser Engagement & Financial Product AdoptionTechnologies UsedAndroid / iOS SDKREST APIsThird-Party FD SDKSecure Payment GatewayKYC Verification APIsMobile Banking AppOverviewProblemSolutionModulesOutcomesTechnologies💬
